# Blake

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** minister  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Blake has lank, tow-colored hair and green eyes. He is also characterized by having a big mouth.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)_

## Personality

Blake is a person who takes matters seriously. Unlike others such as [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), he approaches things with a grave and earnest demeanor.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018)_

## Traits

- takes things seriously  <sub>[v3 ch.Charming P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018)</sub>

## History

[Jonas](../character/jonas.md) Blake tried to avoid becoming a minister for a long time before taking charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church for the summer as a theological student. While there, he stayed at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse and met [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who initially found him funny and ugly. However, after delivering a deeply moving sermon, he earned her profound admiration and left her wondering if she was falling in love with him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023), [v3 ch.Christine P2](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0002), +24 more_
